$comment: Client disclosure projection of the shared state dataset. Same ground truth as the internal view; figures are identical by construction, not by transcription.

funnel.label: Discovered
funnel.definition: A row exists in the capability source registry.

funnel.label: Triaged
funnel.definition: A human or process assigned a disposition, or moved the verdict off the default discovery_candidate.

funnel.label: Rated
funnel.definition: Carries at least one observed fact about the source itself. Stars, tags, age and README claims are explicitly NOT evidence (R3).

funnel.label: Forked
funnel.definition: We own the code: an Actionist block declares this source as its donor at a pinned revision.

funnel.label: Built
funnel.definition: A block manifest exists with linked records under blocks/.

funnel.label: Qualified
funnel.definition: Qualification status is an affirmatively qualified value. Read by allowlist: an absent or unrecognised status is never qualified.

funnel.label: Admitted
funnel.definition: Admitted for a named host and tenant scope, read by allowlist. Never "reusable on the internet", and never inferred from the absence of a rejection.
